info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exceptions API provides a comprehensive view of exceptions related to logistics shipments. This API allows users to retrieve a list of current exceptions that may affect the delivery and handling of shipments, enabling proactive management and resolution of issues. Typical consumers include logistics coordinators, supply chain analysts, and operations managers who need to monitor shipment statuses and address potential disruptions. This functionality supports improved decision-making and operational efficiency in logistics management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of shipment records that are currently flagged as having exceptions. Use this to monitor and manage shipments that require attention.

requestBody.description: This request body includes the necessary parameters to retrieve exception information about shipments. Ensure to send the appropriate JSON structure that adheres to the defined schema.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
